name: Dagger Swarm, Minor
body:
School conjuration [summoning]; Level: sorcerer/wizard/summoner 1, witch 1

Components: V,S

Casting Time: 1 round

Range: Close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)

Effect: One small 5 ft. swarm of daggers

Duration: concentration

Saving Throw: None; Spell Resistance: no

You summon a small 5 ft. x 5 ft. swarm of floating, diminutive, magic daggers (treated as a small swarm of bats with a fly speed of 20 ft. and a swarm attack that inflicts 1d4 damage, but with no 128 bat swarm wounding effect), which attacks all creatures within its area. (You may summon the swarm so that it shares the area of other creatures.) If no targets are within its area, the swarm attacks or pursues the nearest creature as best it can. The caster has no control over its target or direction of travel.
